findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_plan, search_offers, get_faq, get_country_info, get_cross_border_rule, get_border_zone, search_comontel_knowledge, search, fetch · Private data: search, fetch · Public sink: get_plan, get_roaming_allowance, get_border_zone · Destructive: search.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_plan, search_offers, get_faq, get_country_info, get_cross_border_rule, get_border_zone, search_comontel_knowledge, search, fetch · Private data: search, fetch · Public sink: get_plan, get_roaming_allowance, get_border_zone · Destructive: search

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
